Patient: 2 years, A 2-year-old male with diarrhea for 3 days presenting with lethargy and poor oral intake.

TRIAGE LEVEL: 🔴 EMERGENCY
Life-threatening. Refer to hospital IMMEDIATELY.

SUSPECTED CONDITIONS:
  • Severe Dehydration (95% confidence)
  • Very Severe Disease (90% confidence)

RECOMMENDED ACTIONS:
  1. Give fluid for severe dehydration (Plan C) immediately if trained, or start pre-referral fluids.
  2. Refer URGENTLY to the nearest hospital.
  3. Keep the child warm and prevent low blood sugar during transport.
  4. Encourage the mother to continue breastfeeding or giving sips of ORS on the way if the child can swallow.

REFERRAL NOTE (for health facility):
  2-year-old male presenting with 3 days of diarrhea, lethargy, and poor oral intake. Classified as Severe Dehydration and General Danger Sign present (lethargic). Urgent referral for IV fluids and further management.

BASED ON:
  • GENERAL DANGER SIGNS
  • ASSESS AND CLASSIFY DIARRHOEA
